user_fields.notes: Total formal charge of the whole modeled species. Proven value: `0`. Use `0` for neutral species and explicit positive/negative integers for ions.

user_fields.name: spin_multiplicity
user_fields.notes: **The verified API payload uses a string.** Proven value: `"1"`. Use `"1"` for singlet, `"2"` for doublet, or `"3"` for triplet; set radicals and metal systems explicitly.

user_fields.name: dispersion
user_fields.notes: Proven value: `"D3BJ"`. Exact UI options: `D3`, `D3BJ`, `D4`, or `None`.

user_fields.name: experiment_name
user_fields.notes: Pass as the third argument to `submit_request`; it becomes the top-level `experimentName`. Proven value: `"Single_Point_Energy_test"`.

user_fields.name: sirna_fa
user_fields.notes: Uploaded `.fa` or `.fasta` containing one or more candidate siRNA records.

user_fields.name: mrna_fa
user_fields.notes: Uploaded `.fa` or `.fasta` containing the target mRNA record.

user_fields.name: input_fasta
user_fields.notes: Uploaded target RNA/mRNA `.fa` or `.fasta`. Raw sequence is not accepted in this field.

user_fields.name: input_csv
user_fields.notes: Uploaded CSV with the exact columns below.

user_fields.name: min_gc
user_fields.notes: Inclusive minimum GC percentage, from 0 through 100.

user_fields.name: max_gc
user_fields.notes: Inclusive maximum GC percentage, from 0 through 100 and not less than `min_gc`.

user_fields.name: protein_Path
user_fields.notes: Uploaded binding-pocket or protein `.pdb` path. Raw sequence, local paths, PDB text, and HTTP URLs are invalid.

user_fields.name: no_of_shapes
user_fields.notes: Number of shapes to generate; minimum 1. Send an integer, not a string.

user_fields.name: no_of_decodings
user_fields.notes: Number of decodings; minimum 1. Send an integer, not a string.

user_fields.name: model_category
user_fields.notes: Optional model category. The verified sample used exact value `ML`.

user_fields.name: custom_models
user_fields.notes: Optional. Omit it or send `[]` when no custom model is selected. A non-empty custom-model item schema has not yet been live-verified, so do not invent one.

user_fields.name: global_models
user_fields.notes: For every selected property, the user must specify min_threshold and max_threshold. Never infer bounds.

user_fields.name: chains_to_design

user_fields.name: residue_positions_to_design

user_fields.name: generation_count
